RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; a signal source's transmit port cabled to the antenna input through a 20 dB fixed attenuator, nothing radiating; source levels relative only
candidate_space: stages: ref (FILT_CODE 0, FILT_BW 00, HPF 1111: the widest documented codes, also the repeatability check for code 0 of the next stage); FILT_CODE 0..=15 (BW 00, HPF 1111); FILT_BW 0..=3 (CODE 0, HPF 1111); HPF 0..=15 (CODE 0, BW 00); per setting the tone's IF from 100000 Hz to 12000000 Hz in 100000 Hz steps; R30 bit 6 the matrix's 1
procedure: LO fixed at the LO for --freq; the tone at LO -/+ IF (the IF side per --lo-side); the source re-levelled once at the reference setting with the tone at the DDC's IF, then fixed for every curve, so every curve is comparable and the -3 dB corners are read against the ref curve (which carries the demodulator's own response); DDC track: pset_iffreq follows the tone, 1000000 Hz below it (0 when the tone is lower), so the demodulator's channel filter is centred near the tone and the curve is the tuner's
line_legend: k flt; st stage; c FILT_CODE; bw FILT_BW; h HPF; fi the tone's IF (Hz); rf the tone's RF; dd the DDC's IF (Hz); m the meter's median; md every named meter's median; r raw; e errors
